'''''Dragon''''' was TSR's role-playing magazine. Issue 230 (June 1996) printed [[Rick Swan]]'s Star Wars CCG review [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game (Dragon 230)|Star Wars Customizable Card Game]] on pages 113–114.<ref name="dragon230" />

The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
